findings.title: Parser temporary-directory failure leaked its admission semaphore
findings.resolution: Release admission on directory setup failure; explicit tmpfs directory; ENOSPC/EDQUOT507. Two failures cannot brick parser into permanent429.
findings.runtime_scope: Actual network-none read-only parser image with real tmpfs inode ENOSPC:507,507, successful text parse after freeing storage;0.029s. Production parser9 restart is coordinated by root.

findings.title: Scheduled publication had no terminal operation and skipped current publisher authorization
findings.resolution: Persist operation/actor/review pins; fresh worker fence and scope/role checks; terminal success/failure; duplicate scheduling reuses one operation; nested transaction rolls back late publication failures.

findings.title: An employee could authorize a VISUAL citation but its source handler required HR edit permission
findings.resolution: After citation owner/current-source authorization, serve its exact immutable extraction page through a private file-only helper. General HR review preview remains HR-only.

findings.title: Operator model validation could occupy the MAX business worker
findings.resolution: LOCAL_AI_VALIDATE belongs to ingest partition with250-second lease. Answer jobs remain in their own worker; MAX_UPDATE stays in business partition.

findings.title: Fresh connected deployment lacked the semantic review artifact required to activate FULL
findings.resolution: Explicit operator import verifies exact manifest/files and retrieval/renderer identities before copying the separately scoped review. Missing/stale report remains a blocked activation.
findings.runtime_acceptance: Release10 scoped20-case semantic review PASS, strict report import completed, native selected profile validation10/10PASS and activation completed. HTTP100 remains a separate gate; old report is not current proof.

findings.title: FR-KB-012 had dependency invalidation but no native structural revision comparison
findings.resolution: Bounded read-only same-document comparison with exact extraction pins, physical-page/kind/reading-order alignment, metadata/text/table/image-hash changes, honest truncation and unavailable-history labels.
findings.limits: 60physicalpages,1000blocks/extraction,4000textchars/page-side,512KiB response. No semantic page movement or legal impact inference.

findings.title: A failed generation could quote only two parents while its only relevant evidence was third
findings.resolution: After generation failure return every complete retrieved parent only if complete rendered text plus actual source footer fits3500characters; otherwise explicit EVIDENCE_TOO_LONG_FOR_SAFE_EXTRACT handoff. No source conditions are cut.

notes: Exception marker classes use pass legitimately; parser exception cleanup paths are not placeholder success.
Worker fallbacks produce explicit HANDOFF/EXTRACT states and preserve failure reason; unknown job types raise and enter durable retry/failure, rather than reporting success.
CORE lexical extraction is explicitly limited; FULL model failure does not silently manufacture embeddings or call an external model.
Synthetic classifier fixtures and demonstration source review remain labeled and are not company-domain quality claims.

reviewed: OCR, embeddings, reranking and generation execute outside the API request event loop in isolated workers/local services.
Candidate and QA routes enqueue durable jobs; checkpoints do not retain KG/job locks across model requests.
Generator admission, inference time and request budget are bounded; controlled503 failure timings are retained.
Current source/employee scope is rechecked; private citations and MAX source assets do not expose a public unauthenticated document URL.
Models cannot execute tools, credentials, shell commands or domain actions. Health exposes artifact identity, not document text.
residual_limits: Upload async handlers still perform bounded synchronous SQL/filesystem/hash work; slow storage or unusually high concurrent uploads require a separate operational load assessment.
Local lexical recall scans permitted SQL chunks. Large-corpus CPU scale is not established by the small demonstration corpus.
Mechanical citation/number checks cannot prove semantic truth; known raw-model failures remain recorded and guarded.
